items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I forget the name of the people. But Florence Mills was the star.

ctx.x: Yeah, Danny, to continue our conversation about the early days: You mentioned the vaudeville act, the Tennessee Ten. What did they do?

Well, when I got to New York, I found out about the Tennessee Ten. I forget the name of the people. But Florence Mills was the star. She later starred in The Blackbirds. Florence Mills was one of the stars, dancers of the girl performers, what you call a soubrette. She came out front and she done her thing, and she danced with the little chorus there. There was ten people, but they were very compact, what you would call a revue, a small revue or a small tab show. You could play the side-show in a carnival. You…
